status: no blocking findings in the reviewed heartbeat cleanup change
scope: Independent read-only source review and isolated native synthetic builds. No product or test source edits.
checks: NativeReady retains g_base, disabled-state and current game-thread requirements. HostReady still additionally requires a shared mapping and a nonzero heartbeat within the existing 5-second unsigned tick window.

InspectNative executes the same code, globals, current-player, role, backlinks, scene, controller and input checks previously used by Inspect. Inspect continues to gate this native path with HostReady.
Only CompleteRelease requests Access::Cleanup. Acquire and Reapply still pass Preflight with Access::Mutation and therefore Inspect. Observation uses the existing snapshot admission.

CompleteRelease still requires the resolved Actor generation, MovementReady, pending-release state, exact applied field bits, valid originals and writable addresses. External replacement is preserved, and terminal completion unpins.
TrainerFrame invokes the release path at first host expiry and continues Tick with g_hostExpired. The former repeated HostReady refusal is removed without bypassing native blockers.

The joint fixture exercises the shared TrainerBridge, GameplayState, Movement, Role and ActorLifetime guard and journal paths. Besides native callback forwarders and private image setup, KH2_ACTOR_LIFETIME_TESTS hooks replace installation provenance: MEM_IMAGE classification, query/protect bindings, random instance generation and module pinning. The fixture does not validate installation in the live game.

The joint tests cover Sora, Roxas and rescue Mickey with missing, stale and future heartbeats; reject new Acquire/Reapply; defer cleanup behind native blockers; restore after blockers clear; preserve changed fields; and avoid writes after observed Actor death.
limits: This validates the heartbeat cleanup change under the existing actor-lifetime contract. It does not resolve the separately documented native lifetime, worker or bulk-teardown coverage gaps.
MovementReady still requires the shared mapping through damage_tuning::Ready; the reviewed scenario is a stale or missing heartbeat in a retained mapping, as used by TrainerFrame.
Lifetime installation provenance is supplied by test hooks; passing the shared guard, role and journal paths does not validate the live installer.
No game process, native KH2 function, injection, UI or save operation was used.
